row.proto: void Ai_Build_SpeedProfileAhead(void *alloc, void *ai_car_record, float lookahead, int vehicle_index, bool flag, void *out_vec_float)
row.notes: Samples the route ahead every 5 m: n = lookahead/5 + 2 samples starting at the car distance [[R+0x40]+0x108]+0x9e8+idx*0xa70 (wrapped/clamped like 0x14060d830). Per sample: value = Ai_Get_SpeedLimitAtDistance (0x140651335) * zone scale (Ai_Calc_GripLimitBlend at 0x1406517ea, between the route zone objects found by walking marker blocks r+0x4a0/r+0x4a8). Each value is clamped to [0, max_test_radius] (node 0x146046c60) and mapped by Ai_Table_InterpolateD 0x14068fd10 (getter 0x14063b790, fallback getter 0x14063bda0 when result < 1) over R+0x158, then pushed into out (alloc/vec at out+8..+0x18). Then out[0] = current speed [R+0x38]+0x3c and a forward pass caps each next sample with the reachable value from Ai_Table_UpdateKeyCache 0x14068ab50 (0x140651e96) + Ai_Table_InterpolateB/A on table R+0x60 (key from R+0xf8..+0x150); optional 0x140686a40 when flag. Reads general settings via the 0x146046c78 guard (4 sites). (renamed 2026-11-14 from Ai_Unk_140650f90: the code contradicts the old name) L2 2026-11-14 (engine-re AI round): decomp read and claims checked against the disassembly; references from a full rel32/riprel/abs64 scan of .xtls/.xtext/.data1. raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-14 at user request (lane owner review requested) Clarified 2026-11-16: the per-sample value is the turn radius (Ai_Get_TurnRadiusAtDistance, renamed from Ai_Get_SpeedLimitAtDistance) and the zone blocks r+0x4a0/r+0x4a8 are the corner_end/corner_start line tables (channels 2/3), r+0x498 the brake lines. edited by engine-re with --force 2026-11-16 at user request (lane owner review requested)
